title: One row of the store, less every field an outsider wrote
description: The body of an ingestion.record log record: one row of one store table, as JSON, holding its keys, states, hashes, versions, tags, zones and decisions. The record's ingestion.record.kind attribute names the table, ingestion.record.id the row, and ingestion.record.version its version, so a reader folds the rows on those three. Every field an outsider wrote ships in the ingestion.text record of the same kind, id and version, which schemas/ingestion-text.schema.json describes. The table's columns are this row's fields and that row's together.

item_key.description: An item's key, which names the artifact: reddit/<fullname>, youtube/<video id>, url/<16 hex>, file/<16 hex> or memo/<16 hex>, and <parent key>#<n> for a child.

zone.description: Who wrote the content: outside for an outsider, owner for the owner. The strictest wins, and outside is stricter.

stage.description: A stage that writes an output or holds a task. A poll's task fetches a connector's source before any item lands. quality-arm is the quality gate's prompt asked of the model that its task names, as a measurement, and sits on no item's line. note drafts a model read's note where the read carries no person's note. structure profiles a PDF's outline, page labels, creation date, title and fonts. contents is a model's reading of the printed contents pages of a PDF whose outline gave it no sections. topics is a model's split of an owner's memo into one child item per topic. delete removes a landed item from the source of a connector that declares after_landing delete, and sits on no item's line. prompt-proposal drafts a prompt proposal from the quality gate's misses, and sits on no item's line. comments reads what a video's top comments say about it, when a person asks on its review card, and sits on no item's line. refresh-metrics reads again, at a source, the metrics of each item in review that a connector of the source sighted, writes them onto those sightings, and sits on no item's line.

presented.description: A review card as the person saw it when they decided, so a stated preference reads beside how the card was shown: the sort and grouping in force, its rank under the sort and its position from 1 among the rows shown once the filter and the folds hid theirs, how many rows were shown, the quality gate's quality, fit, verdict and side guess with their confidences, null where the gate gave none, and when the card was drawn.

severity.description: A scan finding's severity, from least to most severe.

finding.description: One scan finding without its span: its rule, its severity and where its match sits.

rule.description: The rule's id: a converted ATR rule's, such as ATR-2026-00001, or one of ingestion's own, such as ingestion.command.

unit.description: The unit of the parse that the match starts in, and null for a text that belongs to no parse.

offset.description: Where the match starts, in bytes from its unit's start, or from the text's.

length.description: The match's length in bytes. Its span keeps at most the first 1024.

tokens.description: A model run's tokens by kind.

items.title: items, one row per artifact
items.description: ingestion.record.id is the key. The title and URL ship as ingestion.text.

media_type.description: The artifact's media type, such as text/html or application/pdf.

blob_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the item's bytes, which the blob volume or a home in homes holds. Null where the item landed no bytes, such as a link not yet fetched.

parent_key.description: The item this one was split from, such as the export a Reddit save came in.

parent_flow_id.description: The flow of the write that landed the item.

source_ts.description: When the artifact was made at its source, such as a Reddit post's creation, and null where its source gives no time. Absent from a record shipped before the store kept it.

phase.description: Where the item stands, as the store decides it from the item's records in every write that changes them. A change of phase ships the item again, so a reader counts by this rather than deriving it. Absent from a record shipped before the store kept it.

sightings.title: sightings, one row per item and connector
sightings.description: ingestion.record.id is <item key>/<connector>. The connector's own key for the artifact, such as a canonical URL, ships as ingestion.text.

connector.description: The connector's name, as its declaration gives it.

tags.description: The tags the connector or its source gave this arrival, which the side gate reads first.

cursor_position.description: The connector's cursor where this arrival was read.

metrics.description: The source's counts by name, such as a video's duration_s, views, likes and comments. Each name holds the newest value that carried it, from the connector's arrivals or from the daily refresh of an item waiting in review. A refresh leaves out a views, likes or comments count that reads 0, which the source also answers where it hides one. No outsider wrote them. Absent from a record shipped before the store kept them.

first_seen_ts.description: When the connector first sighted the item.

last_seen_ts.description: The last arrival that changed the sighting. A refresh of its metrics leaves it as it is.

written_ts.description: When the store last wrote the row, on an arrival or on a refresh of its metrics. The row's stamp is written_ts, or last_seen_ts where written_ts is null. Null or absent on a row written before the store kept it.

metrics_read_ts.description: When the metrics were last taken from the source, by an arrival that changed them or by a refresh that read them, changed or not. Null where no read stamped them, and absent from a record shipped before the store kept it.

blobs.title: blobs, one row per SHA-256
blobs.description: ingestion.record.id is the SHA-256. A blob is written once.

homes.title: homes, one row per blob and place a file already lives
homes.description: ingestion.record.id is <sha256>/<root>/<path_sha256>. The path under the root ships as ingestion.text, because whoever named the file may be an outsider.

root.description: The named root the path resolves under, such as books.

modified_ts.description: The file's modification time, to the nanosecond, when its bytes were last hashed at this path. A file whose size or modification time differs is hashed again before it is read as the blob.

gone_ts.description: When the file left its root. The item stays.

outputs.title: outputs, one row per item, stage, producer and version
outputs.description: ingestion.record.id is <item key>/<stage>/<producer>/<producer_version>. A parse's units are rows of parse_units. Each finding's span, a model's answer and an error's text ship as ingestion.text.

producer.description: What wrote the output: an extractor, a rule set or a stage's prompt.

producer_version.description: The extractor's, the rules' or the prompt's version, so a new one replays beside the old.

lens.description: The lens a model read answered under.

input_producer.description: The producer of the parse this output read: the parse a scan's findings index the units of, or the parse a model stage's prompt quoted. A model stage's answer counts as current only while it names the parse that its stage quotes now, such as the item's reading parse.

input_version.description: The producer version of the parse this output read.

lens_version.description: The version of the lens a model read answered under.

note_digest.description: The hex SHA-256 of the note a model read answered, trimmed, and null where it answered none. A read of a new note replaces the item's read under the same prompt.

state.description: waiting holds a model stage's dispatch that has not answered, done holds its output, failed holds why in the text, and deferred holds a parse whose extractor found no text of its own and handed the item to another, such as a video with no caption track that Whisper transcribes.

dispatch_id.description: A model stage's dispatch, stored in the write that ends the worker's lease.

run_id.description: The run that answered the dispatch.

model.description: The model a model stage asked its run for, an alias such as haiku or a model id.

effort.description: The effort a model stage asked its run for, such as medium.

answered_model.description: The model that a model stage's run reports answering on, such as a model id where the stage asked for an alias. Null while the run has not answered, or where it names none.

findings.description: The scan's findings, or a model read's over its suggestion sentence, in the order the matches sit in the text. A done scan that found nothing holds an empty list. Each matched span ships as ingestion.text.

rules_version.description: The scanner rules' version that made the findings: a scan's over its parse, and a model read's over its suggestion sentence.

fit.description: The quality gate's 0 to 10 of how well the item bears on the owner's current work, and null where the gate read no context of that work.

side_guess.description: The quality gate's guess at the side.

parse_units.title: parse_units, one row per unit of one parse, appended
parse_units.description: ingestion.record.id is <item key>/<extractor>/<extractor_version>/<n>. A parse's whole text is its units' text in order, joined by a blank line. Each unit's label and text ship as ingestion.text.

extractor.description: The extractor that wrote the parse, which its outputs row names as the producer.

extractor_version.description: The extractor's version, which its outputs row names as the producer_version.

n.description: The unit's place in the parse, from 1.

sections.title: sections, one row per entry of one item's sections, appended
sections.description: ingestion.record.id is <item key>/<producer>/<producer_version>/<n>. One producer version's rows are written once, beside every other version's. A part holds chapters, and a chapter holds sections. Front and back matter, such as a preface or an index, keep their kind and are no chapter. Each title ships as ingestion.text.

producer.description: outline where the rows come from the PDF's own outline, or are one section over the whole of a short PDF that has none. contents where they come from the book's printed contents pages.

producer_version.description: The version of the rule that wrote the rows and of each output it read, such as 1/pdf-structure@<version>/pdf-text@<version>, where each version is the producer version of the output the rule read.

n.description: The entry's place among its version's rows, from 1, in the outline's order.

parent_n.description: The n of the entry that holds this one, and null at the top.

level.description: The entry's depth, from 1 at the top.

kind.description: part above the chapter level, chapter at it and section below it. front-matter and back-matter are entries at or above the chapter level whose titles name them, such as contents, a preface, an appendix or an index.

pdf_page_start.description: The first PDF page, from 1. A positional parse holds PDF page n as unit n.

pdf_page_end.description: The last PDF page: the page before the next entry at its level or above begins, its own start where that one begins on the same page, or the book's last page.

printed_page_start.description: The first page as the book prints it: its page label, else the PDF page less the book's measured offset, and null where neither gives one.

printed_page_end.description: The last page as the book prints it, found as printed_page_start is.

start_placed_by.description: How the start page was found: outline from the outline entry's own target, whole-file for one section over a short PDF with no usable outline. A contents entry's is label where a page label names its printed page, offset where the page less the book's measured offset gave it, title where the search for its title near that page, or after the entry before it, found it, and next-entry where it printed no page and takes the next placed entry's start.

child_key.description: The key of the item made for a chapter, which takes the item's side and read decisions, and null on every other row. A version written after the item held chapters names the item of the chapter with the same start page and title, and null where none matches.

topics.title: topics, one row per topic of one memo, appended
topics.description: ingestion.record.id is <memo key>/<n>. A memo's topics are written once, in the write that lands each as a child item, and they cover every unit of the parse they split, in order, with no gap and no overlap. Each title and idea ships as ingestion.text.

n.description: The topic's place among the memo's topics, from 1, in the memo's order.

child_key.description: The topic's item, <memo key>#<n>, which is placed as an item of its own.

first_unit.description: The first unit of the memo's parse that the topic holds, from 1.

last_unit.description: The last unit of the memo's parse that the topic holds.

producer.description: The producer of the topics output that answered.

producer_version.description: The version of that output, which is the topics prompt's.

input_producer.description: The extractor of the memo's parse that the answer split.

replays.title: replays, one row per replay that queued a stage again, appended
replays.description: ingestion.record.id is the replay's id, which derives from the caller and its Idempotency-Key. A replay holds no outsider text.

connector.description: The connector whose sightings selected the items, and null for every connector.

item_key.description: The one item the replay selected, and null for every item.

placed_by.description: person where the replay ran only over the labeled items, each that a person placed after the gates sent it to review, as a measurement of the stage against each placement, and null where it ran over every item it selected.

model.description: The model that a measurement arm's replay asked each task's run for, and null for every other replay.

items.description: How many items the replay queued a task for.

requested_by.description: Who asked: person:<login> or service:<client id>.

decisions.title: decisions, one row per gate decision, appended
decisions.description: ingestion.record.id is <item key>/<gate>/<sequence>. A decision holds no outsider text.

sequence.description: The decision's place among the item's decisions at this gate. The newest decides.

verdict.description: quality: pass, drop or review. side: personal, fleet, review, drop where the destination takes no side or a person dropped the item, or split where the item is a memo whose topics each landed as an item of its own. read: as-is, model, archive where a person archived the item, its record kept with no destination and no delivery, review where a note's draft fell below the note floor, or shelf on a record written while review offered a shelf, where a person put the item there and nothing read it until they opened it.

decided_by.description: tag, rule:<name>, model:<run id> or person:<login>, or gate where the side gate's rungs ran out with no guess to read. A read decision's rule is a connector's name, or <side>-default. parent:<book key> marks a chapter's copy of its book's decision, which keeps the book's verdict, cause and confidence.

cause.description: What decided. The quality gate writes pass, drop, unsure, or below-drop-floor where it would drop the item below its confidence floor. The side gate writes tags, tags-disagree, rule, rule-would-hide where an accepted rule's review share drew the item, guess, below-floor, person-sorts, owners-words where the item holds the owner's own words, which the quality gate never reads, no-guess, gate-error, gate-would-drop where the quality gate dropped the item and a family of it has not earned hiding it, quality-drop where every family hides it, quality-review, or topics where a memo split into its topics, and the read gate connector, side-default, note-draft where the read answers the note stage's draft, by the model where the draft reached the note floor or by a person who took it, or note-unclear where the draft fell below the floor. A person's placement or drop names an aspect at the side gate, such as subreddit, channel, theme or title, or unstated. A placement by one of review's choices names the choice at the read gate, as `ingestion review place --help` lists them. An archive names what the person liked at the side gate, channel, theme or this-item, or unstated, and archive at the read gate. A record written while review offered sort verbs and a shelf names a verb at both gates, shelf-open or shelf-remove at the read gate, or learning-refused where the quality gate did not pass an item a person sorted to learning. When a person's push names its destination, the side gate and the read gate each write push.

destination.description: A placement's destination, one the destinations file names.

note.description: The questions and why the item was saved, as a person wrote them, on their placement and on the model read it chose.

lens.description: How a model read takes the item, on a read decision whose verdict is model: the side's lens, or the lens of the choice that a person picked, such as suggestion's fleet lens. A shelf decision written while review offered one names the lens that its opening read under.

client_id.description: The client that sent a person's decision, such as a service sending it under the person's login.

decided_after_ms.description: How long after its review card was drawn the person decided, in milliseconds, and null where no card preceded the decision.

playlist.description: The playlist that a person's watch adds the video to, as its source names it, on the side decision that places it on a destination whose deliverer adds videos to a playlist. Null on every other decision. Absent from a record shipped before the store kept it.

deliveries.title: deliveries, one row per item and destination
deliveries.description: ingestion.record.id is <item key>/<destination>. A delivery is written pending when its task is queued. Its last error, title, URL and path ship as ingestion.text, because each can quote the item.

destination_id.description: The id of the destination's record that holds the item, or that a refusal names.

outcome.description: delivered-to-existing is a record that the destination held before the write, as its answer to that write said: one under no key that took the item's key, or, for learning-resources, one that the key already named. A retry whose first answer was lost reads delivered under life-articles, and delivered-to-existing under learning-resources. refused is a destination's answer naming an existing record that conflicts with the item, kept with that record's id and never retried.

attempts.description: How many writes of the item the destination answered or failed.

source_ts.description: The item's source time when the delivery was first queued, which every attempt sends, and null where the item held none then. Absent from a record shipped before the store kept it.

book_destination_id.description: For a book's chapter, the destination's id for its book's record, from the book's settled delivery when the chapter's was first queued, which every attempt sends. Null for every other item. Absent from a record shipped before the store kept it.

pdf_page_start.description: For a book's chapter, its first PDF page, from 1, as the newest sections naming it held it when the delivery was first queued, which every attempt sends. Null for every other item. Absent from a record shipped before the store kept it.

pdf_page_end.description: For a book's chapter, its last PDF page, kept as pdf_page_start is.

printed_page_start.description: For a book's chapter, its first page as the book prints it, kept as pdf_page_start is, and null where the book gives no way to tell.

printed_page_end.description: For a book's chapter, its last page as the book prints it, kept as pdf_page_start is, and null where the book gives no way to tell.

playlist.description: For a watch, the playlist that the delivery adds the video to, from the side decision when the delivery was first queued, which every attempt sends. Null for every other deliverer. Absent from a record shipped before the store kept it.

tasks.title: tasks, one row per task
tasks.description: ingestion.record.id is the task's id. A stage's task names its item, a poll's task names its connector, a prompt-proposal task names its prompt proposal, and a refresh-metrics task names its source. A failed task's error ships as ingestion.text, because an extractor's stderr can quote the item.

connector.description: The connector a poll's task fetches for.

destination.description: The destination a deliver task writes its item to, and null for every other task.

model.description: The model that a measurement arm's task asks its run for, and null for every other task.

sighting_connector.description: The connector whose sighting a delete task removes from that connector's source, and null for every other task. Absent from a record shipped before the store kept it.

proposal_id.description: The prompt proposal that a prompt-proposal task drafts, and null for every other task. Absent from a record shipped before the store kept it.

source.description: The source whose metrics a refresh-metrics task reads again, and null for every other task. Absent from a record shipped before the store kept it.

capability.description: What a worker needs to claim the task: poll:<source> for a poll, parse:<extractor> for a parse, deliver:<deliverer> for a delivery, delete:<source> for a delete and refresh-metrics:<source> for a refresh of metrics.

held_by.description: The connector that holds this queued task: by a person's hold on it, as its cursor's held_ts records, or by its first fill at a model stage. No claim takes it until a person releases the connector.

lease_token.description: The fencing token. A report under an older token is refused.

attempts.description: How many claims leased the task, but each that ended waiting on the task's far end or on a stopping worker.

lapses.description: How many leases in a row lapsed with no report accepted. Any accepted report sets it to 0, and the claim that finds a third fails the task. Absent from a record shipped before the store kept it.

waiting_since_ts.description: When a report first said the task waits on its far end or on a stopping worker, and null where none has. A retry of a failed task clears it. Absent from a record shipped before the store kept it.

cursors.title: cursors, one row per connector
cursors.description: ingestion.record.id is the connector's name. due_at and stale_at are the scheduler's, which every view of freshness copies. A poll's position ships as ingestion.text, because its source writes it.

due_at.description: When the scheduler next makes the connector due. A connector whose finished_ts is set keeps that time here and is never due or overdue again, so a reader of overdue reads finished_ts first.

stale_at.description: When a poll or a folder declaring a freshness goes stale: its last delivery plus that freshness. Null where the connector declares no freshness or has delivered nothing, and absent from a record shipped before the store kept it.

last_delivery_ts.description: The newest arrival the connector landed.

last_error_ts.description: When the connector's newest run failed. Null once a run completes.

failures.description: How many runs in a row failed. The scheduler retries a failed run sooner than its schedule, waiting longer after each.

first_fill.description: none until an item reaches a model stage. held once one has, which keeps every later item at the model stages until a person releases it.

first_fill_item_key.description: The one item a held first fill ran end to end.

held_ts.description: When a person held the connector, and null while it is not held. A held connector runs no poll or scan, and holds its queued poll and every queued task of an item it sighted, at any stage, until a person releases it. Absent from a record shipped before the store kept it.

hold_decided_by.description: Who held the connector: person:<login>, or service:<client id> where a service held it. Null while it is not held, and absent from a record shipped before the store kept it.

finished_ts.description: When a connector scheduled once ran a poll that landed everything it found, after which the scheduler never runs it. Null until then and for every other connector, and null again once an apply declares the connector other than once. Absent from a record shipped before the store kept it.

created_ts.description: When an apply first declared the connector. A due time with no run or delivery before it counts from here.

declarations.title: declarations, one row per applied set
declarations.description: ingestion.record.id is the applied commit. Applying a commit again stamps its row again, and the newest applied_ts is the set in force.

commit.description: The commit the set was applied from: a full SHA, the SHA marked +dirty.<digest of the set> where the directory held uncommitted changes, or uncommitted.<digest> outside git.

applied_by.description: The login that applied the set.

keyed_requests.title: keyed_requests, one row per request a caller keyed
keyed_requests.description: ingestion.record.id is the caller and the key. A retry under the key answers status and answer again, and a request with another fingerprint is refused.

caller.description: The client, and the person where the token named one.

route.description: Which keyed route took it: drops, a dropped file; runs, a started connector run; or pushes, a pushed link.

fingerprint.description: The SHA-256 of what the request asked, which a retry repeats.

status.description: The HTTP status the request answered.

answer.description: The body the request answered, such as schemas/push.schema.json for a drop.

family.description: A family of the quality gate: one connector under one version of the gate's prompt, answered by one model at one effort, as <connector>@<prompt version>@<model>@<effort>.

family_model.description: The model of a family of the quality gate: the model that its runs report answering on, else the model that they asked for, and default where they named none. A new one starts a new family at rung 0.

family_effort.description: The effort that a family's runs asked for, and default where they named none. A new one starts a new family at rung 0.

marks.title: marks, one row per mark a person gave an item, appended
marks.description: ingestion.record.id is <item key>/<sequence>. low-quality says the item held nothing worth keeping, and read that it was read and gave what was wanted. Each row keeps the quality gate's newest decision on the item when it was made, and whether the mark agreed with it. A mark holds no outsider text.

sequence.description: The mark's place among the item's marks. The newest is the person's word now.

decided_by.description: person:<login>, whether the person's own token sent it or a service sent it naming them, and service:<client id> where a service holding ingestion.marks.write named nobody. Each counts as a person's word.

client_id.description: The client that sent the mark, such as a service sending it for a person.

gate_verdict.description: The verdict of the quality gate's newest decision on the item when it was marked, and null where the gate had decided nothing. A book's chapter reads its book's.

prompt_version.description: The version of the gate's prompt that answered that decision.

agreement.description: low-quality agrees with a drop and disagrees with a pass, and read the other way round. A review, or no decision, is neither.

families.description: Each family that the mark counted on: one per connector that sighted the item, under the decision's prompt version. Empty where the mark was neither, or agreed with a pass, which shows its item whatever a family's standing.

gate_trust.title: gate_trust, one row per family of the quality gate
gate_trust.description: ingestion.record.id is the family. The row caches the standing that earnedtrust reads from the family's gate_trust_decisions and its promotion. Each write ships a version, so the rows folded on version are the family's climb. A promoted family shows share of the gate's drops, picked by a seeded draw over the family and the gate's answer, and drops the rest with cause gate. A family on rung 0 shows every drop as gate-would-drop.

prompt_version.description: The version of the quality gate's prompt. A new one starts a new family at rung 0.

rung.description: 0 while every drop shows, 1 once promoted and earned, and higher as straight runs lower the share.

run.description: The run of a person's agreements with the gate's drops on this rung.

straight_run.description: The run of a person's agreements with the gate's drops since the last disagreement, across rungs.

share.description: The share of the gate's drops that the family shows, 1 on rung 0.

threshold.description: The straight run that earns asking for a promotion, and that climbs each rung above 1.

first_share.description: The share of drops that rung 1 shows, where a promotion starts the family.

asks_promotion.description: True on a family that nobody promoted whose straight run reached threshold, which earns asking a person to promote it.

promoted_by.description: person:<login> who promoted the family, and null before.

promoted_client_id.description: The client that sent the promotion, such as a service sending it under the person's login.

last_change.description: What moved the row last: the gate's first answer under the family, or a later answer on an item that a person gave a word on, after which the item counts under the later answer; a mark; a person's placement on a destination of an item whose drop the gate showed or hid; a promotion; or a release whose rule reads the family's decisions to another standing.

last_item_key.description: The item that the last change moved on, and null for a promotion or a rule.

gate_trust_decisions.title: gate_trust_decisions, one row per person's word that counts on a family's ladder, appended
gate_trust_decisions.description: ingestion.record.id is <family>/<sequence>. A family's rows, in sequence, are what earnedtrust reads its standing from: a mark that agrees with the gate's drop, a mark that disagrees with its answer, and a placement on a destination of an item whose drop the gate showed or hid. A mark that agrees with a pass writes none. A row holds no outsider text.

sequence.description: The row's place among the family's decisions.

kind.description: mark, or placement where a person placed on a destination an item whose drop the gate showed or hid.

promoted.description: True where the family was promoted when the gate answered the item, so an agreement climbs past the promotion. An agreement on a drop answered before it counts toward the promotion alone.

decided_by.description: person:<login>, or service:<client id> for a service's mark that named nobody.

client_id.description: The client that sent the word.

gate_decided_by.description: model:<run id> of the gate's decision that the word judged.

prompt_proposal_miss.description: One answer of the quality gate that a person's word went against, as a prompt proposal's draft reads it. Every field is a key, an enum, a number or the person's own words. It never holds a title, a URL, the item's text, the gate's domains, themes, idea or reason, or a sighting's fields.

n.description: The miss's number within its proposal, from 1, which the draft's answers cite.

connectors.description: Each connector that sighted the item.

label_kind.description: placement where a person placed the item after the gates sent it to review, and mark where a person marked an item that the gate had decided.

label.description: The person's word: personal, fleet or drop for a placement, and low-quality or read for a mark.

destination.description: Where the person placed the item, and null for a drop or a mark.

cause.description: What the person said decided the placement, such as title, theme or a sighting field's name, and null for a mark.

note.description: The note that the person wrote with the placement, and null where they wrote none.

review_cause.description: Why the item waited in review before the person placed it, and null for a mark.

labeled_ts.description: When the person gave the word.

missed.description: What the word went against: verdict, side, or both.

prompt_version.description: The version of the quality gate's prompt that answered.

genre.description: One of the gate's genres, an enum of prompts/quality/answer.schema.json.

prompt_proposals.title: prompt_proposals, one row per drafted change to a model stage's prompt
prompt_proposals.description: ingestion.record.id is the proposal's id. serve writes the row when a time of its [gates.proposals] schedule finds misses labeled since the last done proposal, with the misses that the draft reads and the text of the prompt that it changes. It queues the prompt-proposal task that drafts it. A failed draft's misses are read again by the next proposal. The task's run writes the rest, as a model stage writes its output, so each version of the row is a step of the draft. zone is owner, because every miss holds only keys, enums, numbers and a person's own words, and a model's output takes its input's zone. A draft that is done names its edits in answer.

prompt.description: The stage whose prompt the draft changes.

prompt_version.description: The version of that prompt that the draft changes.

prompt_text.description: The template of that prompt at prompt_version, as serve's build held it. The draft quotes it and its edits apply to it, so a worker of another build drafts against the same text.

labeled_after.description: The misses were labeled after this time: the labeled_through of the newest done proposal, and null where none is done, so the draft reads every miss before labeled_through.

labeled_through.description: The misses were labeled at or before this time: the schedule's time that drafted the proposal.

misses.description: The projection that the draft reads, the earliest label first.

producer_version.description: The version of the prompt-proposal prompt that drafts it.

state.description: waiting until the draft's run answers, then done, or failed where the run failed or its answer did not apply to the prompt.

dispatch_id.description: The dispatch that the queue adapter follows, and null for a run that answered at once.

model.description: The model that the run asked for.

effort.description: The effort that the run asked for.

answered_model.description: The model that the run reports answering on.

answer.description: The draft, whole, as prompts/prompt-proposal/answer.schema.json holds it: pattern, change, edits and answers. Each edit's before occurs once in prompt_text, and no two overlap, so applying the edits gives the proposed prompt. Null until the draft is done.

error.description: Why the draft waits or failed.

routing_rules.title: routing_rules, one row per version of a routing rule that a person accepted, appended
routing_rules.description: ingestion.record.id is <name>/<sequence>. The newest version of a name is in force unless it is retired, and the side gate reads each rule in force at its rule rung, after every rule that routing-rules.yml declares. A block drops each item that the rule matches as rule:<name>, and a keep places it on destination. review_share of the matched items wait in review instead, marked rule-would-hide, picked by a seeded draw over the rule's name and the item's key. match_values ships as ingestion.text, because each copies a source's field.

name.description: The rule's name, which its decisions' decided_by names as rule:<name>.

sequence.description: The version's place among its name's versions, from 1.

action.description: block drops what the rule matches and keeps its row. keep places it on destination.

match_connector.description: Holds for an item this connector sighted, and null where the rule names no connector.

match_tag.description: Holds for an item a sighting tagged with this, and null where the rule names no tag.

match_field.description: A field of a sighting whose value one of match_values must be, and null where the rule names no field.

destination.description: A keep's destination, and null on a block.

review_share.description: The share of the matched items that wait in review as rule-would-hide.

retired.description: True on a version that takes the rule out of force, which copies the version before it. An item that the rule placed stays where it is.

proposal.description: The proposal that the person accepted, and null where none did.

decided_by.description: person:<login>, or service:<client id> where a service holding ingestion.routing-rules.write named nobody.

client_id.description: The client that sent the version.
